lines.zh: 六条腿小步交替，像轮子转。
lines.en: Six legs step in turn like a turning wheel.
I walk slowly and stay steady.
I move along the grass with my head down.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子往前伸，一路嗅。
lines.en: My snout reaches ahead, sniffing.

lines.zh: 我贴着坡边走，避着碎石。
lines.en: I hug the slope's edge, clear of the scree.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像在盘算什么。
lines.en: I step and pause, as if reckoning something.

lines.zh: 我跟在同伴后面，不远不近。
lines.en: I follow a herdmate, neither close nor far.
I cross the young grass light-footed.
I turn and head down the slope.
I walk along a row of trees.
My legs are short, but I miss no step.
Following the wet mud, I work to the shallows.
I carry the shield on my back as I walk.

lines.zh: 我被草叶挡住，绕了过去。
lines.en: A blade blocks me and I go round.
I pause one step and go on.

lines.zh: 我沿着自己的气味找回去。
lines.en: I follow my own scent back.

lines.zh: 我伏着，背上的盾一动不动。
lines.en: I crouch with the shield on my back still.
I lift my snout and sniff.
I chew slowly with froth at my lips.
I tuck all six legs beneath me.

lines.zh: 我盯着一只小虫看了很久。
lines.en: I watch a small bug for a long while.
I make no sound; I only wait.
The wind moves my ears.
I rest my head on the ground.

lines.zh: 背上的盾被太阳晒得发热。
lines.en: The shield on my back grows hot in the sun.
I shift my weight back and forth.
I scratch my neck with a forelimb.
I listen to the sounds in the grass.
I fear nothing; slow is slow.
I doze with my eyes half shut.
I burp and it tastes bad.
I turn my body another way.
I lift my head and look at you slowly.
I stretch my snout toward you.
I neither hide nor come near.
You carry the smell of grass.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，判断你的高度。
lines.en: I tilt my head to judge your height.

lines.zh: 我的背盾看起来比我还大。
lines.en: The shield on my back looks larger than me.

lines.zh: 我看了你一会儿，低下了头。
lines.en: I watch you a while and lower my head.
When you move, my legs tighten.
You crouch, and only then do I see all of you.

lines.zh: 我什么都没做，只是看着。
lines.en: I do nothing; I only look.
If you reach for me, I will not run.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口气，草动了动。
lines.en: I snort and the grass stirs.
I bleat and take two steps back.
The blow lands on my shield with a thud.
All six of my legs tremble.
I tuck my head and turn the shield to it.
It hurts, and my shield still covers me.
I back into the grass.
Blood seeps out from under the shield.
I slowly straighten, panting.
I keep that beneath my shield.

lines.zh: 盾边缺了一角，我照样走。
lines.en: A chip off my shield's rim; I walk on anyway.
One sniff and over I come.

lines.zh: 你把草递过来，我低头吃。
lines.en: You offer grass and I lower my head to eat.
This mouthful is tender.
I eat slowly and chew fine.
Hold your hand still; I fear biting it.
Done, I lift my head to you.
The grass by the path is not this good.

lines.zh: 吃到一半，我抬头听风声。
lines.en: Halfway through, I lift my head to listen.
The smell of grass makes me forget to hide.
You move three steps and I move three.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子快碰到你的手了。
lines.en: My snout is nearly at your hand.
A little more and I will not leave.

lines.zh: 我用嘴唇轻轻卷走草叶。
lines.en: I curl the grass away with my lips.
Green froth rings my mouth.
When you move, I lift my head.
That mouthful is so tender I squint.
You hit my shield and bounce off.
I am heavy and hard to move.

lines.zh: 你顶在我的盾上，没顶动。
lines.en: You shove my shield, and it doesn't budge.

lines.zh: 我被挤得歪了一下，站住。
lines.en: I lurch and catch myself.
You knocked my snout aside.

lines.zh: 盾被顶了一下，我晃了晃。
lines.en: A shove on my shield makes me sway.
This crowded, my legs cannot turn.
I back into the grass.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，我把身子横住。
lines.en: You crowd in; I turn broadside.
Next time I will push back.

lines.zh: 它的鼻尖蹭过我的盾沿。
lines.en: Its snout grazes the rim of my shield.
It rubs my neck for me.

lines.zh: 我们并排伏着，步调一样。
lines.en: We lie abreast in the same rhythm.
I walk one full round about it.
It moves and so do I.
We nip at the same grass blade.
It strays and I bleat once.
Two bodies doze pressed together.
I rest my chin on its back.
It did not leave, and neither did I.

lines.zh: 我用嘴唇卷起一撮嫩芽。
lines.en: I roll up a tuft of young shoots with my lips.

lines.zh: 我用嘴唇卷起一片叶子。
lines.en: I curl a leaf with my lips.
This leaf is too old to chew.
I dip and bite through the root.
I pin it by my foot.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞着草，说不出话。
lines.en: My mouth's full of grass; I can't speak.
I spit it out; not good.

lines.zh: 我用门牙啃断一截根茎。
lines.en: I nip through a root with my front teeth.
This piece is bitter.
Done, I look for the next tuft.
The grass stirs and my head comes up.
I have accepted that dark shape.

lines.zh: 我压声一叫，同伴都抬头。
lines.en: I call low and the herd lifts its heads.
I turn my shield toward it.

lines.zh: 草伏下去，我知道它在哪。
lines.en: The grass bends; I know where it is.
I drop my frame low.
The wind carries that smell over.
I paw the soil with a forelimb.
I step in front of my herdmate.

lines.zh: 锁定之后，我慢慢往后退。
lines.en: Once locked on, I back away slowly.

lines.zh: 我一直看着它，盾对着它。
lines.en: I keep watching it, shield toward it.
It wheels about and I turn my body slowly.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子缩到盾后，等它动。
lines.en: I tuck my snout behind the shield and wait.
I back into the grass step by step.

lines.zh: 它进一步，我就压低一点。
lines.en: It steps in and I sink a little lower.
I tuck my snout behind the shield.
We hold at a standstill.
It tries my back and I turn first.
All my legs are taut.
One more step and I butt.
Head down, my shield arrives first.
I shoulder into it.
My forelimbs land on its legs.
That shove drives it back.
I bite its foot.
It strikes my shield and slides off.
I butt again, harder.
It retreats and I hold.
My shield's rim draws a line on it.
Done, I pant with my head still low.

lines.zh: 我从草里站起来，六条腿撑开。
lines.en: I rise from the grass and spread six legs.

lines.zh: 背上的盾比我先被看见。
lines.en: The shield on my back is seen before I am.
The grass is thick here, which suits me.
I dip for a mouthful of grass.
Herdmates come along behind me.

lines.zh: 风从侧面来，我换了个方向。
lines.en: Wind on my flank, so I turn.
I raise my head and listen.
The soil is soft.

lines.zh: 我从坡下的草丛里直起腰。
lines.en: I straighten up from the grass below the slope.

lines.zh: 这里没有比我大的东西。
lines.en: Nothing here is larger than me.

lines.zh: 火烤到我的盾，我翻过来压灭。
lines.en: Fire reaches my shield and I roll to smother it.

lines.zh: 落地时六条腿一起撑，闷响一声。
lines.en: All six legs brace on landing with a thud.
Muddy water blinds me; my legs thrash.
The blast flips me with my shield skyward.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进盾缝，我扭身去蹭。
lines.en: Something lodges in a shield seam and I rub at it.

lines.zh: 冷意钻进皮下，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Cold seeps under my hide and I shudder.
Too hungry to even lift my head easily.

lines.zh: 雷打在盾上，我全身都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shield and numbs me all over.
No ground below and I fall away.
